g.text: The companion to windows-perf-journey-log. Same numbers, linear axis: the whole 2.5 GbE era is the bottom tenth of
the chart, and the first bar is a sliver. That is what 80× looks like when it is not flattened by a log scale. Each bar is what
was measured at that commit, in that session; this laptop throttles, so only same-session comparisons are exact.
Windows: Dell Latitude 7490, i5-8350U (4 cores / 8 threads, 15 W) · Linux: Ryzen 7 PRO 7840U (16 threads) · Thunderbolt networking, MTU 65330, link 20 Gbit/s
